# hcloudplus Provider

Terraform provider for Hetzner Cloud's undocumented console API (projects, project tokens, members, activities, limits). Wraps hcloud-go-plus.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    hcloudplus = {
      source = "hatemosphere/hcloudplus"
    }
  }
}

# All auth is driven by HCLOUDPLUS_* environment variables by default.
# See the provider README for the full list.
provider "hcloudplus" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://api.hetzner.cloud/v1. Useful for recording/replay or tests.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Hetzner Cloud Console password. Required when user_token is not set. Can also be set via HCLOUDPLUS_PASSWORD.
- `totp_cmd` (String, Sensitive) Shell command whose stdout (trimmed) is the current 6-digit TOTP code. Example: "op read 'op://vault/accounts.hetzner.com/one-time password?attribute=totp'". Required when user_token is not set. Can also be set via HCLOUDPLUS_TOTP_CMD.
- `user_token` (String, Sensitive) Account-level user token extracted from a logged-in Hetzner Cloud Console session. Mutually exclusive with username/password/totp_cmd. Can also be set via the HCLOUDPLUS_USER_TOKEN environment variable.
- `username` (String) Hetzner Cloud Console username (robot login / client number or account email). Required when user_token is not set. Can also be set via HCLOUDPLUS_USERNAME.
